in_marathi.name: Sejal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sejal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sejal in Sanskrit means ‘seashell’, which is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sajalam’. The name is associated with the sea, the beach, and the joy and happiness that comes with being near water.
